# Research Guides at University of Cincinnati

> UC Libraries' comprehensive research guide platform providing subject-specific guides, database access, and academic resources for students and faculty across all disciplines.

Powered by LibGuides and Springshare's LibApps, this portal serves the University of Cincinnati community with curated research guides spanning law, engineering, business, arts, sciences, and humanities. The guides provide access to databases, course-specific resources, and subject expertise to support academic success.

## Key Topics

- Research guides
- Academic databases
- Subject guides
- Legal research
- Library resources
- MATLAB
- LSEG Workspace
- Government documents
- Fine art research
- Engineering resources
- Business research
- Music education
- Geography and environmental science
- LibGuides
- Database access

## Core Portal & Discovery

- [Home - Research Guides at University of Cincinnati](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu): UC Libraries research guides portal powered by LibGuides
- [A-Z Library Databases](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/az.php): Directory of UC Libraries databases with access and troubleshooting info
- [Online Reference Shelf Research Guide](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/reference): Online reference shelf with curated databases and research resources

## Subject & Discipline Guides

- [Political Science and International Affairs - SPIA](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/spia): Political science and international affairs research guide for SPIA
- [Geography & Environmental Science Resource Research Guide](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/geography): Geography and environmental science research guide for UC students
- [Music Education Research Guide](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/music_education): Music education research guide supporting College-Conservatory curriculum
- [DAAP Library Fine Art Research Guide](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/fineart): Fine art research guide with top resources from DAAP Library
- [Government Documents Information Resource Guide](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/govdocs): Guide to government documents including federal, state, and UN resources

## Engineering & Technology Resources

- [MATLAB Resources Research Guide](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/MatlabForEngineers): MATLAB tutorial and resources guide for engineering students
- [BME2000: Biomedical Engineering in the Clinical Environment](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/bme2000): Course guide for BME2000 biomedical engineering clinical research
- [LSEG Workspace](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/workspace): Guide to LSEG Workspace financial data and trading tools for business

## Law & Legal Studies

- [Poverty and the Law Research Guide (IRTS-7017)](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/povertylaw): Legal research guide for poverty law seminar course IRTS-7017
- [Animal Law Research Guide](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/animallaw): Animal law research guide for UC legal studies students
- [Bankruptcy Research Guide](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/bankruptcy): Bankruptcy law research guide for UC legal studies students
- [Resiliency & Wellness for Law Students & Lawyers Guide](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/lawwellness): Mental health and resiliency resources for law students and lawyers

## Academic Programs & Courses

- [Teaching English as a Foreign Language Research Guide](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/teaching_ESL): TEFL research guide supporting second language studies curriculum
- [Faculty Research at UCBA](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/ucba-facultyresearch): Faculty research support guide for UCBA College programs

## Support & Accessibility

- [Finding Permalinks: the move to a more accessible format](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/permalinks): Guide to finding and using accessible permalink formats for resources

## Optional

- [New Books Blog - New Materials at Frederick A. Marcotte Library](https://guides.libraries.uc.edu/UCCNewBooks): Blog featuring new books and materials at UC Clermont's Marcotte Library
